prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: an interior wall of vertical dark wooden planks with a horizontal rail, like inside an old inn.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a wide horizontal 2:1 pixel-art texture strip of ONLY the straight-on VERTICAL FRONT FACE of a raised interior wall/ledge in a top-down JRPG tileset. Full bleed edge-to-edge, horizontally tileable: the left and right edges match perfectly, including all rail lines, plank edges, tones, and top/bottom bands. Represent roughly 256 x 128 square art pixels, displayed at nearest-neighbor scale, consistent crisp square pixels throughout. At the very top 6% a thin warm lit wooden rim/lip of the raised upper level, absolutely no visible upper floor surface; below it the FRONT FACE made of dark vertical wooden boards inside a worn old inn, with a continuous horizontal wood rail running across the face. Plank seams vertical, subtly irregular widths, deliberate compact pixel clusters showing grain and aging, controlled understated detail. Face tones gradually deepen toward bottom; bottom 8% a dark contact band where wall meets floor, with NO floor visible. Premium modern hand-placed hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art; crisp orthogonal pixel boundaries, clusters of 3–10 art pixels, no diagonal vector edges or smooth rendering. Rich earthy 4–6-shade wood palette; warm yellow highlights and saturated purplish-red brown shadows. Neutral, even, softly upper-left-lit clean base color, no cast shadows or light sources. Entire frame comprises only this flat straight-on front wall surface, not a scene or a side view. NO objects, furnishings, windows, doors, sky, floor, vignette, glow, blur, antialiasing, photoreal textures, random noise, or dithering checkerboards.
